item.title: GitHub Actions + golangci-lint: Go Version Compatibility Matrix (with Copy/Paste Workflows)
item.author: technicalblog123@arran4.com (Arran Ubels)
item.description: If you use this in GitHub Actions: - name: golangci-lint uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v9 with: version: latest you are absolutely right to be cautious: latest can move to a new golangci-lint release that adds support for a new Go minor while your workflow, runner, or repo expectations are still pinned to older assumptions. This guide gives you: a practical version pairing table (Go ↔ golangci-lint ↔ action), safe version ranges you can reuse, and many copy/paste workflow examples.
